# TensorRT 11.2 headers

The public C++ headers DUAL's TensorRT plugins compile against (`nodes/impl/tensorrt/dual.py`),
from NVIDIA's open-source TensorRT repository, tag `v11.2` (https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT/tree/v11.2/include),
Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`). Their content equals the TensorRT 11.2.1.2 SDK's headers; only the line ends differ.
Build Engine's optional TensorRT SDK Path uses an SDK's own headers instead.
